adaptive_damping_policy: compute_adaptive_damping (kinematics/adaptive_damping.py): lambda(sigma_min) = lambda_min if sigma_min >= threshold, else lambda_max - (lambda_max - lambda_min) * (sigma_min / threshold)^2; continuous at threshold, monotonically non-increasing in sigma_min, clipped to [lambda_min, lambda_max]
clipping_policy: clip_to_operational_limits = true (kinematics/joint_limit_utils.clip_to_operational_limits, elementwise clip into [operational_lower_rad, operational_upper_rad]); applied only after a joint-limit violation is detected post-step, never implicitly
description: Immutable snapshot of the locked pure-DLS candidate (cand_D_pure_dls) that SR-PPO-DLS builds on top of. This file records source/config hashes and resolved solver parameters as of the snapshot commit; it is never regenerated to match a later commit without a new, explicit re-lock decision.
jacobian_frame: world (space frame); kinematics/jacobian.py::geometric_jacobian_world via mujoco.mj_jacSite, restricted to the resolved dof addresses of joint_1..joint_7
joint_limit_policy: joint_limit_avoidance = false, null_space_gain = 0.0 (cand_D_pure_dls isolates the pure DLS term by disabling the null-space joint-centering secondary task that other candidates use)
pose_error_convention: position_error = target_position - current_position (Euclidean, meters); orientation_error = Log(R_target @ R_current.T)^vee (SO(3) logarithm map, radians); full 6-vector ordering is [position_x, position_y, position_z, rotation_x, rotation_y, rotation_z] (kinematics/pose_error.py::full_pose_error)
pose_error_frame: world (left/space frame); body-frame Log(R_current.T @ R_target)^vee is numerically different and must not be mixed with the world-frame Jacobian without an explicit conversion
